# doit_customer_notification (Resource)

Manages an organization-wide notification: the notification types it subscribes to, such as cost anomalies, invoices, digests and insights, and where it is delivered.

Slack channel IDs and Microsoft Teams conversation IDs are supplied by you; the API has no lookup for them yet. A channel that is deleted, archived or disconnected later stays in `destinations` without an error, so a listed channel does not guarantee delivery.

A notification that also holds a type the API does not expose (a dashboard, report or commitment subscription, or a prompt schedule, added in the DoiT console) cannot be read through the API, so Terraform treats it as deleted.

~> **Note:** Managing notifications requires the `settings` (Manage settings) permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    doit = {
      source  = "doitintl/doit"
      version = "~> 1.0"
    }
  }
}

# Notify about every cost anomaly of at least warning severity whose excess
# cost is above $100. All three destination lists are required; use [] for a
# type you do not use. Email recipients must be users of your organization.
resource "doit_customer_notification" "all_anomalies" {
  name = "All cost anomalies"

  destinations = {
    emails         = ["finops@example.com"]
    slack_channels = []
    teams_channels = []
  }

  settings = {
    cost_anomalies = {
      min_severity    = "warning"
      min_excess_cost = { amount = "100.00", currency = "USD" }
      allocations     = { mode = "all", ids = [] }
    }
  }
}

# Only critical anomalies of specific allocations, delivered to Slack and
# Microsoft Teams as well as by email. Slack channel IDs and Teams conversation
# IDs are the ones the DoiT console shows for your connected channels.
# Allocation IDs must belong to custom single allocations.
resource "doit_allocation" "production" {
  name        = "Production"
  description = "Production workloads"
  rule = {
    formula = "A"
    components = [
      {
        key    = "project_id"
        mode   = "is"
        type   = "fixed"
        values = ["my-production-project"]
      }
    ]
  }
}

resource "doit_customer_notification" "production_critical" {
  name = "Critical production anomalies"

  destinations = {
    emails         = ["finops@example.com"]
    slack_channels = ["C0123ABCD"]
    teams_channels = ["19:abc@thread.tacv2"]
  }

  settings = {
    cost_anomalies = {
      min_severity    = "critical"
      min_excess_cost = { amount = "1000.00", currency = "USD" }
      allocations = {
        mode = "include"
        ids  = [doit_allocation.production.id]
      }

      # Resend while the anomaly is active: every 12 hours, and whenever its
      # cost grows by 20% or by $500 within 6 hours. Remove the block to turn
      # resending off.
      repeat = {
        every_hours = 12
        when_cost_grows = {
          match            = "or"
          percent_increase = 20
          min_increase     = { amount = "500.00", currency = "USD" }
          within_hours     = 6
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

# Billing and insight notifications for the FinOps channel in Slack. Set a
# type to {} to subscribe with its defaults; an omitted or empty filter list
# means every value. Removing a type from the configuration unsubscribes it.
# expert_insights and data_integration_sync_failure cannot be delivered to
# Microsoft Teams, so teams_channels must stay empty when they are set.
resource "doit_customer_notification" "finops_digest" {
  name = "FinOps billing and insights"

  destinations = {
    emails         = []
    slack_channels = ["C0123ABCD"]
    teams_channels = []
  }

  settings = {
    new_invoices      = {}
    payment_reminders = {}
    expert_insights   = {}
    insights = {
      pillars    = ["cost"]
      severities = ["critical", "high"]
    }
    weekly_digest = {
      allocation_ids = [doit_allocation.production.id]
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `destinations` (Attributes) Where the notification is delivered. All three lists are required; use `[]` for an unused destination type. At least one list must be non-empty. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destinations))
- `name` (String) Display name of the notification (1–200 characters).
- `settings` (Attributes) The notification types the notification subscribes to, one attribute per type. Set at least one; removing a type from the configuration unsubscribes it. `expert_insights` and `data_integration_sync_failure` cannot be delivered to Microsoft Teams. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings))

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) When the notification was created (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `etag` (String) Current ETag of the notification. The provider sends it with updates and deletes to detect changes made outside Terraform.
- `id` (String) The ID of the notification.
- `update_time` (String) When the notification was last changed (RFC 3339, UTC).

<a id="nestedatt--destinations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `destinations`

Required:

- `emails` (List of String) Email addresses that receive the notification, in the configured order. The API stores them in lowercase; state keeps the configured spelling while the address is unchanged. Use `[]` when email is unused.
- `slack_channels` (List of String) Slack channel IDs (such as `C0123ABCD`), in the configured order. Use `[]` when Slack is unused.
- `teams_channels` (List of String) Microsoft Teams conversation IDs (such as `19:abc@thread.tacv2`), in the configured order. Use `[]` when Teams is unused. Requires a Teams entitlement.


<a id="nestedatt--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings`

Optional:

- `aws_billing_data_import` (Attributes) Problems importing AWS billing data. Set it to `{}` to subscribe for every billing profile, or list `billing_profile_ids`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--aws_billing_data_import))
- `cloud_incidents` (Attributes) Cloud incidents. Set it to `{}` to subscribe. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--cloud_incidents))
- `cost_anomalies` (Attributes) Cloud cost anomalies. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies))
- `credit_utilization` (Attributes) Credit utilization. Set it to `{}` to subscribe. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--credit_utilization))
- `cud_approval` (Attributes) PerfectScale for Commitments: a Google Cloud committed use discount purchase requires approval. Set it to `{}` to subscribe. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--cud_approval))
- `cud_purchased` (Attributes) PerfectScale for Commitments: a Google Cloud committed use discount was purchased. Set it to `{}` to subscribe. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--cud_purchased))
- `daily_digest` (Attributes) Daily cost digest of the listed allocations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--daily_digest))
- `data_integration_sync_failure` (Attributes) Data integration sync failures. Set it to `{}` to subscribe. Delivered by email and Slack only: a notification that subscribes to it must have empty `destinations.teams_channels`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--data_integration_sync_failure))
- `expert_insights` (Attributes) New custom insights from the DoiT expert team. Set it to `{}` to subscribe. Delivered by email and Slack only: a notification that subscribes to it must have empty `destinations.teams_channels`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--expert_insights))
- `insights` (Attributes) New DoiT insights. Set it to `{}` to subscribe to every insight, or narrow it with `pillars`, `severities` and `providers`; an insight must match all three. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--insights))
- `monthly_digest` (Attributes) Monthly digest. Set it to `{}` to subscribe. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--monthly_digest))
- `new_invoices` (Attributes) New invoices. Set it to `{}` to subscribe for every billing profile, or list `billing_profile_ids`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--new_invoices))
- `new_proforma_invoices` (Attributes) New proforma invoices. Set it to `{}` to subscribe for every billing profile, or list `billing_profile_ids`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--new_proforma_invoices))
- `new_sku_usage` (Attributes) Usage of new SKUs. Set it to `{}` to subscribe. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--new_sku_usage))
- `payment_reminders` (Attributes) Due or overdue payments. Set it to `{}` to subscribe for every billing profile, or list `billing_profile_ids`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--payment_reminders))
- `quota_utilization` (Attributes) Quota utilization. Set it to `{}` to subscribe. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--quota_utilization))
- `savings_plan_approval` (Attributes) PerfectScale for Commitments: an AWS Savings Plan purchase requires approval. Set it to `{}` to subscribe. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--savings_plan_approval))
- `savings_plan_purchased` (Attributes) PerfectScale for Commitments: an AWS Savings Plan was purchased. Set it to `{}` to subscribe. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--savings_plan_purchased))
- `weekly_digest` (Attributes) Weekly cost digest of the listed allocations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--weekly_digest))

Optional:

- `billing_profile_ids` (List of String) IDs of the billing profiles to notify about, such as `ent_01HEXAMPLEBILLING0001`. Omit it or set `[]` for every billing profile.

<a id="nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.cost_anomalies`

Required:

- `allocations` (Attributes) Allocations whose anomalies trigger the notification. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--allocations))
- `min_excess_cost` (Attributes) Minimum excess cost of an anomaly (not total spend) that triggers the notification. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--min_excess_cost))
- `min_severity` (String) Minimum anomaly severity: `warning` notifies about warning and critical anomalies, `critical` only about critical ones.

Optional:

- `repeat` (Attributes) Resend controls while an anomaly is active. Set `every_hours`, `when_cost_grows`, or both; remove the block to turn resending off. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--repeat))

<a id="nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--allocations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.cost_anomalies.allocations`

Required:

- `ids` (List of String) IDs of custom single allocations, kept in the configured order. Must be `[]` when `mode` is `all`, and non-empty without duplicates for `include` and `exclude`. Preset and group allocations are rejected.
- `mode` (String) `all` — every allocation with anomaly detection enabled (and unallocated anomalies). `include` — only the listed ids. `exclude` — all enabled allocations except the listed ids. `all` cannot be sent with a non-empty `ids`. `include` and `exclude` cannot be sent with an empty `ids`.
Possible values: `all`, `include`, `exclude`


<a id="nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--min_excess_cost"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.cost_anomalies.min_excess_cost`

Required:

- `amount` (String) Amount in whole US dollars, such as `100` or `100.00`. The API returns amounts with two decimals; state keeps the configured spelling while the value is unchanged, but an imported notification has the two-decimal spelling. Must be between `0` and `1000000000`.
- `currency` (String) Currency code. Must be `USD`.


<a id="nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--repeat"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.cost_anomalies.repeat`

Optional:

- `every_hours` (Number) Resend until the anomaly is inactive, every N hours (1–24).
- `when_cost_grows` (Attributes) Resend when the anomaly's cost grows. Set `percent_increase`, `min_increase`, or both. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--repeat--when_cost_grows))

<a id="nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--repeat--when_cost_grows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.cost_anomalies.repeat.when_cost_grows`

Optional:

- `match` (String) How to combine `percent_increase` and `min_increase`: `or` resends when either is reached, `and` when both are. Required when both are set.
- `min_increase` (Attributes) Minimum cost increase that triggers a resend. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--repeat--when_cost_grows--min_increase))
- `percent_increase` (Number) Minimum cost increase in percent (`10` means 10%) that triggers a resend.
- `within_hours` (Number) Only count growth within this many hours (1–24). Omit it to turn the time window off.

<a id="nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--repeat--when_cost_grows--min_increase"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.cost_anomalies.repeat.when_cost_grows.min_increase`

Required:

- `amount` (String) Amount in whole US dollars, such as `100` or `100.00`. The API returns amounts with two decimals; state keeps the configured spelling while the value is unchanged, but an imported notification has the two-decimal spelling. Must be between `1` and `1000000000`.
- `currency` (String) Currency code. Must be `USD`.

<a id="nestedatt--settings--insights"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.insights`

Optional:

- `pillars` (List of String) Insight pillars to notify about: `cost`, `operations`, `performance`, `security` or `compliance`. Omit it or set `[]` for every pillar.
- `providers` (List of String) Insights provider IDs to notify about, such as `aws`, `gcp`, `azure`, `k8s` or `google-workspace` (not invoice platform IDs such as `amazon-web-services`). Omit it or set `[]` for every provider.
- `severities` (List of String) Insight severities to notify about: `critical`, `high`, `medium` or `low`. Omit it or set `[]` for every severity.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import using the notification ID.
terraform import doit_customer_notification.example [notification_id]
```
